title: El culto
goal: Decline an invitation to church without giving offence
culture: He is inviting you because he thinks it would be good for you, which is a kindness by his lights. Thank him for the invitation rather than arguing with the premise, and you will keep a neighbour who genuinely knows the barrio.

beats.es: Hermano, buenas. Lo invito al culto el domingo. Es aquí cerquita.
beats.good: Le agradezco thanks him for the thought before you answer it. It buys the rest of the conversation a friendly tone.

beats.objective: Say it is not your church
beats.good: A fact about you rather than a judgement about him. Arguing the theology is the one move that turns a neighbour into a project.

beats.objective: Say you respect it either way
beats.en: I respect it all the same.
beats.good: Respect without joining. It is the same move as with the beata in Xalteva, and it works for the same reason.

beats.es: Bueno, hermano. Ahí queda la invitación.
beats.good: Quizás otro día is a no that leaves everybody their dignity. He will ask again in a month and that is fine.
